summary: Short kerb beside a shop building, with a block of flats about 15 m across the lane.
reasons: Flats about 15 m across the lane

drivers.seclusion: Retail building on the kerb side; a long block on the west side (mapped as under construction, likely flats) about 15 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow lane, but cars are parked along both sides; 10 m kerb fits a van with little spare.
drivers.traffic: Dead-end side street off a busy road; some local and delivery traffic.
drivers.convention: Signs allow 1P and 2P on weekdays, so overnight parking is the norm; parked cars give cover.

flags: Only 10 m long: a snug fit for a van
Flats likely across the lane at about 15 m
Busy road noise at the north end
Low-lying: about 4.6 m elevation, no mapped waterway
sun_shade: Open to the sky; the shop building shades the kerb from the east in the morning.
cannot_judge: Whether the west block is occupied

best_section.where: East kerb of Mitre Street, just south of Hawken Drive, beside the retail building
